## Read me
Errors Register — Simon Reid (ART 2023/3363) | 
Prepared 26 Sep 2026. Working document — privileged, prepared for litigation. | 
What this is | Every NDIS payment request listed by the CDPP's forensic accountant (Kelly Beckett, Annexures B.1–B.26, R v Vida Reid) for the 23 participants, classified by how the prosecution itself treated it, why it was said to be false, and whether the Hybrid Hive BrightHR roster shows a scheduled shift with that participant in the claim period.
Source files | LEGAL_TEAM_SP\...\CDPP\Service_3\FA\BECKETTKelly_Annex_B_*.pdf; ...\Tom Monks- FFG\Meghan Goodwin Rosters\Rosters- Bright HR.csv; ...\CDPP\Service_2\PMA\*\EML\*.eml
How figures were made | Claims parsed from the annex PDFs (text + table extraction). Row status taken from the annex colour legend: orange = 'Alleged Fraudulent', blue = 'Cancel Requests Offset or Repaid', pale yellow = 'Not Paid / Not Offset'. Rows with no colour are claims the accountant listed but did NOT allege were fraudulent.
Reconciliation | Parsed alleged total $1,475,549 v Annex B summary $1,475,870.97 (difference $322). Per-participant differences exist for Bott, Haidar, Clark, Charlie Harrison (cancelled Hybrid claims) and Yasmine Wilson — use the Annex B summary figure for any total you quote.
Basis categories | C = item type/rate/weekend/travel disputed or accountant says 'possibly'; D = participant elsewhere (overseas/hospital/other residence); E = date/period disputed; F = participant says no service at all; G = basis not stated in the annex. Categories are keyword-based from the accountant's column 23 text — check the PDF row before relying on any single claim.
Roster match | A claim is 'rostered' if a non-declined BrightHR shift names that participant on a date inside the claim's support start–end dates. Roster = scheduled shift, not proof of attendance; export generated by Vida Reid 16 Feb 2024 (header row).
Simon period | Support start date on or after 17 Feb 2022 (Simon's Hybrid directorship per IR 29(c)).
Do not | Do not file figures without checking the source page. Do not quote category labels as the accountant's words.
